notes.title: We're exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2024!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[h3][b]Live Hard, Die Hard is exhibiting again this year at Tokyo Game Show 2024, the most major gaming event annually held in Japan![/b][/h3]
Last year, we were so pleasantly surprised to see so many game lovers playing our game.
This year's exhibit will be sure to blow your mind with so many newly added features, such as multiplayer mode and so much more!

This year's exhibit will be full of new features, designs... pretty much every part of the game has something new to show!
We are looking forward to seeing all you commanders playing the updated version of the game!

We'll be posting more news as soon as it becomes open!
Don't miss out on the next news!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596675/03adb84daa7d660d7c41be3578d3563d42ebba15.png[/img]

[b]More about Tokyo Game Show 2024[/b]
--------------------------------------
Business Day: September 26th~27th
Public Day: September 28th~29th
Location: Makuhari Messe (International Exhibition Hall 9~11 Indie Game Area, Booth 09-C17)
Other titles to be exhibited: "Live Hard, Die Hard" "ShapeHero Factory" "Vivid World"
Website: https://tgs.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2024/en/

notes.title: The location of the booth at TIGS2024 is now fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
As announced in the Steam News earlier, “Live Hard, Die Hard” will be exhibiting at [url=https://indiegamessummit.tokyo/en/]TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2024[/url] from March 2nd to 3rd in Kichijoji, Tokyo!
If you are planning to come to the event, what a wicked timing you came by this news; we just got an update on the location of our booth at the venue!

[h3][b]Asobism booth will be at…[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Musashino Public Hall 2F Conference Rooms 1~2, A-4a ~ A-4b[/b][/h3]
(1-6-22 Kichijoji Minami-cho, Musashino-shi, Tokyo 180-0003)
[h3][b]Be sure to come visit us![/b][/h3]

We also have some original button badges, waiting patiently to be given out to all the indie game lovers who played our demo! Keep in mind that they are limited in number!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596675/0c75df2ccae5b03c3a39113b00d737ce8157c810.png[/img]
*Image is for reference only

We will keep you updated about the event through our official X page!
[url=https://twitter.com/LHDH_GLB][h2]@LHDH_GLB[/h2][/url]

[h3][b]★Event information★[/b][/h3]
■Event name
TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2024

[b]■Date & Time[/b]
Mar 2nd (Sat), 2024, 13:00-17:00　Business Day
Mar 3rd (Sun), 2024 10:00-17:00　General Public Day
Tickets are required for admission. For information on purchasing tickets and prices, please refer to the official website.

[b]■Venue[/b]
<Main venue>
Musashino Public Hall (1-6-22 Kichijoji Minami-cho, Musashino-shi, Tokyo 180-0003)
Kichijoji Tokyu REI Hotel (1-6-3 Kichijoji Minamimachi, Musashino-shi, Tokyo 180-0003)

[b]■Asobism booth location[/b]
Musashino Public Hall 2F, Conference Rooms 1 & 2, A-4a, A-4b

[b]■More about this event:[/b]
https://indiegamessummit.tokyo/en/


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2550790/Live_Hard_Die_Hard/
